capabilities: Focus on a selected file or folder via a right-click menu item
Hide other files in the file list while focusing
extras: README includes a Chinese-language section; installation is via BRAT or manual copy of plugin files.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer always shows the full vault, with no built-in way to temporarily hide everything except a chosen file or folder.
summary: File-explorer helper that hides all other files in the file list so you can focus on one file or folder.
